# Search Text Ex.vi

![Search Text Ex.vi function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/DF-01.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Uses the DataFinder to search in all of the text properties of the indexed files.
